comment: The one table that maps a tenant residency code to the regions its data may live in. Go embeds this file (platform/go/residency) and deploy/multi-region/tools/residency_report.py reads it; a drift test in each language fails when a copy or a profile differs. Regions are written both as Azure region names (deploy/cloud-profiles/profiles.json) and as the legacy region ids in deploy/multi-region/values (eu-west, eu-central, us-east). An empty list means any region (GLOBAL).

EU.description: EU and EFTA only (the EU Data Boundary scope, issue 605): the 27 EU states plus Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland. The Azure names are the eu-data-boundary overlay's allowedRegions.

US.description: United States only: the commercial US Azure regions (the gcc profile's allowedRegions) and the legacy us-east and us-west ids.

GLOBAL.description: No restriction: any region. The default for a tenant that names no residency.
